items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Did Tony work there or anything? Yeah, Tony worked there. But I wasn't really.

ctx.x: with Tony Parham? I think I played it for you one time. Yeah. What was the Blue Island?

Well that was, uh, there was a place on there called Blue Island. Did Tony work there or anything? Yeah, Tony worked there. But I wasn't really. I see. But it's a place called Blue Island. Yeah, that's way out south in Chicago, Blue Island. Yeah. Was it a nightclub or a town? It's a town,
but there were two, three nightclubs in there. Oh, I see. Did you ever work any jobs with Big Bill?
